# Progression-free survival

This module defines the exploratory PFS analysis.  The analysis population is
the randomized ITT cohort, with time zero at randomization.  PFS is the first
recorded disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.  Participants
without either event are censored at their last evaluable disease assessment
or the fixed administrative end of follow-up.

The primary PFS contrast is the posterior hazard ratio (SAT invitation versus
external comparator) from a Bayesian proportional-hazards model with the same
M-spline baseline-hazard construction used for OS.  The adjustment contract is
treatment, linear age, diagnosis, and ECOG collapsed to 0, 1, 2, and 3+ when
those fields are available.  Missing fields remain missing and must be handled
by the approved analysis input stage; this module does not impute data.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

# The production stage supplies these schema-validated tables.  They are not
# present in the public checkout, so this complete analysis chunk is a
# non-executing contract until the private preparation stage provides them.
cohort <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
)
imaging <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-imaging.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "imaging.yml")
)
progression_events <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-progression-bsc.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "progression_bsc.yml")
)

cohort$randomization_date <- secondary_parse_date(
  cohort$randomization_date, "randomization_date", allow_missing = FALSE
)
imaging$imaging_date <- secondary_parse_date(
  imaging$imaging_date, "imaging_date", allow_missing = FALSE
)
progression_events$event_date <- secondary_parse_date(
  progression_events$event_date, "event_date", allow_missing = FALSE
)

# Earliest progression from either an imaging assessment or the event table.
imaging_progression <- imaging[
  !is.na(imaging$progression) & imaging$progression == 1L,
  c("id", "imaging_date"), drop = FALSE
]
names(imaging_progression)[2L] <- "progression_date"
event_progression <- progression_events[
  tolower(progression_events$event_type) == "progression" |
    (!is.na(progression_events$progression) & progression_events$progression == 1L),
  c("id", "event_date"), drop = FALSE
]
names(event_progression)[2L] <- "progression_date"
all_progression <- unique(rbind(imaging_progression, event_progression))
first_progression <- if (nrow(all_progression) > 0L) {
  aggregate(progression_date ~ id, all_progression, FUN = min)
} else {
  data.frame(id = character(), progression_date = as.Date(character()),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
last_assessment <- if (nrow(imaging) > 0L) {
  aggregate(imaging_date ~ id, imaging, FUN = max)
} else {
  data.frame(id = character(), imaging_date = as.Date(character()),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
names(last_assessment)[2L] <- "last_assessment_date"

# Death is the competing PFS event; a cohort death date is supplemented by a
# coded death event when supplied by the event table.
cohort_death <- cohort[!is.na(cohort$death_date), c("id", "death_date"), drop = FALSE]
event_death <- progression_events[
  tolower(progression_events$event_type) == "death",
  c("id", "event_date"), drop = FALSE
]
names(event_death)[2L] <- "death_date"
first_death <- unique(rbind(cohort_death, event_death))
if (nrow(first_death) > 0L) first_death <- aggregate(death_date ~ id, first_death, min)

pfs_data <- merge(cohort, first_progression, by = "id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
pfs_data <- merge(pfs_data, first_death, by = "id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
pfs_data <- merge(pfs_data, last_assessment, by = "id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
pfs_data$ecog_3_plus <- secondary_collapse_ecog(pfs_data$ecog_fstcnt)
pfs_data$administrative_end <- secondary_date_column(
  pfs_data, "follow_up_end_date", "follow_up_end_date"
)
pfs_data$administrative_end[is.na(pfs_data$administrative_end)] <- as.Date("2026-08-21")
pfs_data$administrative_end <- pmin(
  pfs_data$administrative_end,
  pfs_data$randomization_date + 182L,
  as.Date("2026-08-21")
)
pfs_data$pfs_event_date <- as.Date(NA)
pfs_data$pfs_event_type <- "censored"
pfs_data$event_pfs <- 0L
pfs_data$pfs_censor_date <- pfs_data$administrative_end
pfs_data$pfs_censor_date[!is.na(pfs_data$last_assessment_date)] <- pmin(
  pfs_data$pfs_censor_date[!is.na(pfs_data$last_assessment_date)],
  pfs_data$last_assessment_date[!is.na(pfs_data$last_assessment_date)]
)
for (row in seq_len(nrow(pfs_data))) {
  event_dates <- c(pfs_data$progression_date[row], pfs_data$death_date[row])
  event_date <- if (all(is.na(event_dates))) as.Date(NA) else min(event_dates, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.na(event_date) && event_date >= pfs_data$randomization_date[row] &&
      event_date <= pfs_data$administrative_end[row]) {
    pfs_data$pfs_event_date[row] <- event_date
    pfs_data$event_pfs[row] <- 1L
    pfs_data$pfs_event_type[row] <- if (!is.na(pfs_data$death_date[row]) &&
                                         pfs_data$death_date[row] <= event_date) "death" else "progression"
    pfs_data$pfs_censor_date[row] <- event_date
  }
}
pfs_data$pfs_time_days <- as.numeric(
  pfs_data$pfs_censor_date - pfs_data$randomization_date
)

# Primary PFS model: Bayesian PH with the OS M-spline baseline construction.
pfs_formula <- survival::Surv(pfs_time_days, event_pfs) ~
  tx + age + ecog_3_plus + diagnosis
pfs_fit <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
  formula = pfs_formula,
  data = pfs_data,
  basehaz = "ms",
  basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 17005
)
pfs_log_hazard_ratio_draws <- as.numeric(as.matrix(pfs_fit)[, "tx"])
pfs_hazard_ratio_draws <- exp(pfs_log_hazard_ratio_draws)
pfs_summary <- data.frame(
  estimand = "hazard_ratio",
  median = median(pfs_hazard_ratio_draws),
  lower_95 = quantile(pfs_hazard_ratio_draws, 0.025),
  upper_95 = quantile(pfs_hazard_ratio_draws, 0.975),
  posterior_probability_benefit = mean(pfs_hazard_ratio_draws < 1),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write_atomic_parquet(
  pfs_summary,
  project_path("results", "secondary", "pfs", "summary.parquet")
)
```

No PFS model is run while this contract is rendered without locked analysis
data.  Results are consumed by the assembled report from a compact result
artifact and status manifest.
